language_task: Place the toys on the plate with no collisions.
outcome_evidence: The robot picks up and places the blue, pink, and tan toys sequentially. overhead_cam and wrist_cam show the blue toy released on the plate by frame 275, the pink toy resting on it by frame 476, and the tan toy released by frame 683. Frames 718–756 in both cameras confirm all three toys remain on the plate after the empty gripper withdraws. No failed acquisition, unwanted collision, or harmful side effect is visibly established.
